name: computer_settings
desc: Controls the computer: volume, brightness, window management, keyboard shortcuts, typing text on screen, closing apps, fullscreen, dark mode, WiFi, restart, shutdown, scrolling, tab management, zoom, screenshots, lock screen, refresh/reload page. Use for ANY single computer control command. restart, shutdown and toggle_wifi put a confirmation on the user's screen and do NOT happen until they press it — never claim they are done. Volume, brightness and dark mode can be reversed with the `undo` tool.

name: file_controller
desc: Manages files and folders: list, create, delete, move, copy, rename, read, write, find, disk usage.

name: gmail
desc: Connect Gmail with OAuth or App Passcode, search/read email, save drafts, and send after confirmation.

name: instagram_messaging
desc: Use a connected Meta Instagram professional account to list supported conversations and send messages after on-screen confirmation.

name: moss_check
desc: Check code for plagiarism using Stanford MOSS (Measure of Software Similarity). Uploads source files to Stanford's server and returns a URL with similarity results. Works with Python, Java, C/C++, JavaScript, Haskell, and 30+ other languages. Use when the user wants to check if code is plagiarized, compare code submissions, or check code originality.

name: opero_connect
desc: Remote device pairing, status checking, and execution gateway.

name: opero_dev_agent
desc: Autonomous developer task execution engine. Runs code modifications, builds, and tests.

name: opero_health
desc: Check OPERO configuration and recovery status without changing anything.

name: ppt_builder
desc: Creates a polished PowerPoint (.pptx) presentation from a title, optional subtitle, and a list of slides. Each slide supports: title, kicker (eyebrow label), bullets (list of strings), and notes. Supports themes: auto, neon, corporate, luxury, academic, sunset. Use when the user asks to create a presentation, slideshow, deck, or PowerPoint.

name: recovery
desc: Inspect OPERO recovery history or restore a recorded local backup after on-screen confirmation.

name: task_status
desc: Show recent OPERO action states, results, and failures without changing anything.

name: website_builder
desc: Create an original, deploy-ready static website from a brief in a new OPERO Websites folder.
